## Skills and examples

- [ocean-icechunks-skills](https://github.com/ocean-icechunks/ocean-icechunks-skills): the `virtual-icechunk` and `archive-to-cloud` agent skills
- [ocean-icechunks/icechunks](https://github.com/ocean-icechunks/icechunks): CoastWatch OHC, GOBAI-O2 and OA-indicators stores
- [ocean-icechunks/hycom](https://github.com/ocean-icechunks/hycom): the HYCOM reanalysis stores
- [NMFS HackHours, June 5 2026](https://nmfs-opensci.github.io/NMFSHackDays-2026/topics/2026-06-05/): VirtualiZarr + Icechunk notebooks
- [gridlook](https://github.com/eeholmes/gridlook): a browser viewer for Zarr and Icechunk stores
